title: The Ocean's Hidden Air
hook: Your next breath doesn't come from a forest, but the ocean.
script: Your next breath doesn't come from a forest, but the ocean. We call rainforests the lungs of the planet, but they are mostly carbon-neutral. What if every forest burned, but the plankton survived? You would still breathe, because plankton produce over 50 percent of Earth's oxygen. One microbe, Prochlorococcus, is so abundant it provides one in five breaths you take. Their population is ten to the twenty-seventh power, an army of cells larger than the number of stars in the observable universe. These tiny drifters are the real architects of your survival. Your life depends on the salt water.
